narration.prompt: [low, calm] Late one night in 2004, a woman began posting to a forum from a train that would not stop. [long pause] [quietly] Then she heard drums. And a small bell. Coming closer, along the line. [long pause] [low, slow] Her last post said her battery was low. The thread is still waiting.
narration.takes_note: both takes (290 credits each); take 1 used (20.3 s raw; inner pauses capped at 0.22 s; no tempo change; three lines placed at fixed times); take 2 kept

platform.prompt: An empty rural train platform at night in the countryside: the steady electric hum of an old mercury-vapour lamp, faint insects, a cold wind. No voices, no music, no trains.

train.prompt: Inside an empty local electric train at night: steady rail clatter over joints, a low motor whine, the carriage swaying and creaking. No announcements, no voices, no music.

drums.prompt: Far away across dark fields at night: slow, heavy wooden drums beating and a small bright hand bell ringing, a procession moving, distant and echoing. No voices, no melody.

shout.prompt: A man shouts once, hoarse and angry, from the mouth of a railway tunnel at night, the echo cut off sharply into silence. No music.

ballast.prompt: Close footsteps of one person walking slowly along a railway line at night, shoes crunching on gravel ballast and stepping on wooden sleepers. No voices, no music.

car.prompt: Inside a small car driving slowly up a winding mountain road at night: a quiet engine, tyres on rough asphalt, the indicator ticking now and then. No radio, no voices, no music.
